markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds InSitu only, but the MUSK second model disagrees on top class. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Invasive 6% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.00 percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Mixed; two Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · near typical level, little pull toward invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · well below typical, slightly lowers invasive term · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · above typical; caption check inconsistent · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · above typical; associated with non-invasive · Weak
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · largest term, but not given as a reason · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3, simulated frozen section) hides fine nuclear and architectural detail.
- MUSK disagrees on top class, and 2 of 5 similar cases are Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 2** — highest heatmap contribution to invasive logit; look for invasive foci despite 6% risk.
2. **Region 11** — confirm duct architecture and nuclear atypia; normal-lobule score is unreliable.
3. **Region 7** — check for stromal invasion where the validated invasion concept peaks.
